==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
The alien in their larval form is all white. It has a head shaped like a dumpling. It has a small body shaped like a five pointed star.

In it's adult form it has very long arms and legs. It's arms and legs resemble a red wood like material. I had to draw them over and over again.

I saw them travel around the world in a matter of moments. They move through the sky in saucers. I have some link to them.
